Since 1993,Gyanpeeth Degree College, Nikashi has provided quality higher education to students from rural, tribal, and border areas. Offering Arts and Science streams under Bodoland University and supported by experienced faculty, the college fosters an inclusive, value-based environment. Proudly recognized under Sections 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC Act, 1956, and by the Government of Assam, we invite aspiring students to join our vibrant academic community and pursue excellence.

Principal's Desk
×
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the official website of Gyanpeeth Degree College, Nikashi. The launch of this website marks a significant milestone in our journey towards academic excellence, transparency, and digital advancement.
Established in 1993 with the noble mission of imparting higher education to the poor and underprivileged sections of society, our college has steadily progressed in its commitment to inclusive and quality education. After being provincialised by the Government of Assam in 2013, the institution gained new strength and stability. The introduction of the Science stream in 2024 further reflects our continuous effort to expand academic opportunities for our students.
In this digital era, a website serves as a dynamic platform for communication, information sharing, and academic interaction. Through this portal, students, parents, faculty members, alumni, and well-wishers can access important updates, academic details, achievements, notices, and various activities of the college.
I sincerely hope that this website will strengthen our connection with the community and enhance the visibility of our institution. Let us move forward together with dedication, discipline, and determination to build a brighter future for our students and society.
With best wishes,
Principal (i/c)
Gyanpeeth Degree College
Nikashi
